'''Dahar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked for the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Quesh war]], he was among the Cartel forces deployed to aid the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] in response to the [[Three Families]]' allying withe [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Dahar was stationed at the [[Imperial Garrison (Quesh)|Imperial Garrison]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dahar appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Crew Skill Trade Vendor for Imperial players on Quesh.<ref name="TOR" />
